title: pr-pane 0.3.0: /prs toggle, z collapse, autoOpen option
summary: Let people hide, fold and stop auto-opening the PR pane.
description: A colleague asked for a way to toggle the pane's visibility or expand/collapse it; before 0.3.0 the pane could only be closed with its close mark and reopened with /prs. Requested by Jeremy via evolv-marketplace.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /prs with no argument closes the pane when it is placed and in front, and opens it otherwise; /prs show and /prs hide are the explicit forms
z folds the pane to one summary line of non-zero counts (open, approved, checks failing, conflicts) and z or the expand button restores it on the same selected PR
The folded state is mirrored to $.store and restored at session start; the 60 s poll and new-PR toasts keep running while folded
A boolean autoOpen userConfig field gates $.ui.open at session start without stopping the command, poll or toasts
The new commands and key are listed in COMMANDS, HELP and the README; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1: tests/pane.test.ts '/prs closes a showing pane; show and hide are explicit' passes, and Jeremy ran /prs open/close live in the evolv-prs session.
AC4: tests/pane.test.ts covers autoOpen on and off at session.start (21/21 at c8c9bf6, CI run 39294787496).
AC5: guardrails.test.ts holds every KEYS entry documented in HELP and helpText; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc passed locally, CI passed.

AC2 left unchecked: the summary line and fold/expand are tested (summary() unit test, mount test on terminal and desktop), but no test or live check selected a PR before folding, so 'same selected PR on expand' is unproven.
AC3 left unchecked: the $.store write is tested (stored true/false sequence); the restore at session.start and the poll running while folded are not exercised by any test or observed live.
finalSummary: Shipped pr-pane 0.3.0 (PR #2, squash c8c9bf6, tag v0.3.0, GitHub release). Added the /prs toggle with show/hide, z fold to a one-line summary mirrored to $.store, and the autoOpen userConfig option. Verified by validate --strict, 21/21 plugin tests, strict tsc and green CI, then Jeremy's live test in this repo. evolv-marketplace then installed from the tag, bumped its catalog (PR #21, 754a103) and republished the org library.
